result.summary: Ensure wallet transaction resubmission honors private broadcast when -privatebroadcast=1 is enabled. Currently, periodic wallet rebroadcasts of unconfirmed transactions fall back to broadcasting to all connected peers. It also updates resubmission log messages to include both txid and wtxid as well as the submission outcome.
result.problem: When -privatebroadcast=1 is enabled, periodic rebroadcasts of unconfirmed wallet transactions (sent every 12 to 36 hours) use the standard send-to-all broadcast mechanism. Users expecting network privacy for their transactions risk leaking their IP address on wallet rebroadcast.
evidence: PR description: 'If -privatebroadcast=1 and a transaction is submitted locally with the sendrawtransaction RPC and it is related to the wallet, then the rebroadcasts would use the send-to-all method. Change that to use the private broadcast method.'
result.scope_notes: Small patch in wallet resubmission logic and logging; diff was omitted from the prompt.
result.card: Wallet rebroadcasts of unconfirmed transactions currently use standard network broadcast to all peers even when -privatebroadcast=1 is set. This PR updates wallet resubmission to route transactions through private broadcast when enabled, closing an identity leak where unmined wallet transactions eventually get rebroadcast across standard connections. It also updates wallet submission logging to display both txid and wtxid along with submission results.
